evidence: Whole-repo AST scan found no constant conditions, no async functions lacking await, and no identical if/else branches after excluding intentional framework stubs.

Manual and ruff-assisted review found concrete boolean-expression simplifications: overlays/b12x/attention/indexer/tiled_topk.py (and its aeon-crossnode-graphs duplicate) uses `if cond: return False; return True` instead of a single boolean expression.

Several redundant identity comparisons on booleans were found in production code: `x is False` and `x is True` in overlays/vllm/config/vllm.py, overlays/vllm/utils/torch_utils.py, platform/merged/torch_utils.py, overlays/vllm/v1/core/sched/scheduler.py, overlays/vllm/model_executor/layers/attention/mla_attention.py, and campaign-2026-08/sircl/upstream/scripts/qualify_direct_cable.py (plus aeon duplicates). These can be replaced with direct boolean tests.

Two useless terminal returns were confirmed: `return None` at the end of `send_object` in overlays/vllm/distributed/parallel_state.py and a bare `return` at the end of an inner loader in overlays/vllm/model_executor/model_loader/weight_utils.py (with aeon duplicates). Both are flagged by ruff PLR1711.
Broad and empty except blocks exist, but they are error-contract / contract_coherence issues already surfaced in batch 18, not control-flow logic defects under this rubric.

Guard clauses, early returns, and break/continue patterns in overlays/vllm/v1/core/sched/scheduler.py and attention kernels are deliberate and commented; no confirmed dead-after-unconditional paths were found.

logic_clarity.dimension_character: Control flow is mostly direct and intentional, but the codebase carries a recurring pattern of redundant boolean identity comparisons (`is True`/`is False`) and a few boolean-return helpers that can be collapsed. These are not correctness bugs, but they obscure intent and add unnecessary cognitive overhead across the overlay and campaign modules.
logic_clarity.score_rationale: A score of 72.0 reflects good structural logic clarity—no dead code after unconditional jumps, no constant conditions, and no async-without-await—offset by a cluster of redundant boolean expressions spread across several files. Raising the score above 80 would require cleaning up the `is True`/`is False` comparisons and the SIM103 simplifications.

issues.summary: _should_mark_layout_dynamic uses if/return-False/return-True instead of a single boolean expression
evidence: Line 256: `if tensor.ndim == 1 and int(tensor.numel()) > _SIGNED_INT32_MAX: return False; return True`. This is exactly the `if x: return False else: return True` anti-pattern targeted by the dimension rubric.
issues.suggestion: Collapse to `return not (tensor.ndim == 1 and int(tensor.numel()) > _SIGNED_INT32_MAX)`. Apply the same simplification to the aeon-crossnode-graphs duplicate.

issues.summary: Multiple files compare values to True/False with `is` instead of using the boolean directly
evidence: campaign-2026-08/sircl/upstream/scripts/qualify_direct_cable.py:356, 450, 797-798: `snapshot.get("interface_exists") is True`, `rdma.get("exists") is True`, `sender.get("valid") is True`, `receiver.get("valid") is True`
issues.suggestion: Replace `x is False` with `not x` (or `x is not True`) and `x is True` with `x` when the value is already boolean. If the value may be truthy/falsy but not strictly bool, cast explicitly with `bool(x)` or document the intent.

issues.summary: Two functions end with an unnecessary bare `return` or `return None`
evidence: overlays/vllm/distributed/parallel_state.py:848: `return None` is the final statement of `send_object`; the function already returns None implicitly.
overlays/vllm/model_executor/model_loader/weight_utils.py:1294: bare `return` is the final statement of the inner `composed_loader`; it is redundant.
issues.suggestion: Remove the terminal `return None`/`return`. If the explicit return is meant to signal the end of a long function, replace it with a trailing comment.

root_causes: Carried upstream/overlay code preserves defensive stylistic patterns (`is True`/`is False`, if/return-False/return-True) rather than direct boolean expressions.
Fast bring-up favors redundant explicit returns and identity comparisons that do not change semantics but add noise.
possible_false_positives: Framework-required async methods that legitimately do not await.
Deliberate guard clauses and early returns in complex scheduler kernels.
Broad/empty except blocks are error-contract concerns, better handled under contract_coherence.

add.header: Redundant boolean identity comparisons are the main logic noise
add.description: Multiple overlay and campaign files use `x is True` or `x is False` where a direct boolean test (or `not x`) would be clearer. These are not bugs, but they are exactly the kind of logic-clarity redundancy the dimension targets.

AST scans and manual review did not find dead code after unconditional return/raise/break, always-true/false conditions, identical if/else branches, or async functions without await. Guard clauses and early returns are deliberate.
